datasets.quality_rule: preserve FAOSTAT flags; official, unofficial and imputed values must remain distinguishable
main source UNSD/Eurostat; partner imputation and food-aid additions must retain lineage
source data UN Comtrade; do not count FAOSTAT and Comtrade as independent corroboration for the same cell
preserve source/flag semantics and questionnaire vs external-source lineage

datasets.license: US Government public domain data release

datasets.quality_rule: reference period and unit must be retained; API v2 values may be strings
preview caps and reporter publication lags must be explicit
structural port attributes are not live status and candidate score is not criticality probability

cross_source_rules: FAOSTAT trade values derived from UN Comtrade are not independent corroboration of the underlying Comtrade cell.
Provider-derived analysis and its upstream commercial or official inputs must retain lineage.
Missing values remain unknown rather than zero unless the provider defines a structural zero.
All downstream ratios must preserve numerator, denominator, units and reference periods.
